coverage_verdict: second independent exact-value comparison added; existing Table 6 catalogue unchanged
summary: PertEval-scFM (ICML 2025) Table 1, Norman single-gene section (2,000 HVGs), provides a second, independent, from-scratch GEARS evaluation against a raw-expression MLP baseline and a context-mean baseline, using a different preprocessing, split mechanism (SPECTRA sparsification) and metric (AUSPC) from the existing GEARS Supplementary Table 6 comparison. Only the three AUSPC values for GEARS/MLP baseline/Mean baseline from the Norman single-gene row are added; the five scFM-embedding configurations, the double-gene section, the Replogle K562/RPE1 tables, and the paper's own Delta-AUSPC column are not added.
additions: Added one new source, one dataset subset, one protocol, three configurations, three evaluations and three results (12 records), plus one new proxy mapping (use-case-map-perteval-scfm-norman-single-auspc) on use-case-genetic-perturbation-response. All eight existing GEARS Supplementary Table 6 records and both existing mappings remain byte-identical.
remaining_gaps: A benchmark exists for expression responses on two independent Norman2019-derived comparisons (GEARS Table 6 and this PertEval-scFM addition), but prospective experiment-selection hit rates and transfer to a new cell system remain uncovered by either.

scPerturBench (Wei et al., Nat. Methods, DOI 10.1038/s41592-025-02980-0; 27 methods x 29 datasets x 6 metrics) is confirmed genuinely paywalled; its Methods were not read and no record is derived from it.

No frozen, matched Norman control panel with a predeclared metric-sensitivity check and a separately registered context-transfer protocol has been executed; this is the focused gap tracked at rewire-benchmarks #29, which this source-transcription intake does not close.
